ingredients.name: ground meat, such as beef, pork or turkey
kidney beans, 29 ounces each, with liquid
black beans, 29 ounces each, with liquid
pinto beans, 29 ounces each, with liquid

steps.instruction: Cook 2 pounds of ground meat in a large pot over medium-high heat.
steps.spoken: Cook 2 pounds of ground meat in a large pot over medium-high heat, until it is no longer pink.

steps.instruction: Drain off the fat and throw it away.
Add 2 cans of tomato sauce and 2 cans of diced tomatoes.
Add 2 cans each of kidney beans, black beans and pinto beans.
steps.spoken: Add 2 cans each of kidney beans, black beans and pinto beans, with the liquid from the cans.

steps.instruction: Add 2 cups of water, 1 diced onion and 2 diced celery stalks.
Add 3 teaspoons of cumin powder and 3 tablespoons of chili powder.
Add 2 teaspoons of black pepper and 2 teaspoons of salt.
Turn the heat to low and simmer for 2 hours, stirring now and then.
steps.spoken: Turn the heat to low and simmer for 2 to three hours, stirring now and then.
